chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from 'Umar ibn Yazid, who said:

I heard Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام saying: “In the Book of 'Ali عليه السلام: the drinker of wine and the drinker of an intoxicant are both to be struck.” I said: “How much?” He said: “Their hadd is one.”

key_terms.حَدُّهُمَا: The prescribed legal punishment for both of them
key_terms.شَارِبُ الْمُسْكِرِ: One who drinks an intoxicating substance
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: The written legal record attributed to Imam 'Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: Is to be flogged or struck as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for drinking wine and other intoxicants in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling transmitted from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام and attributed to the Book of 'Ali عليه السلام. It establishes that the punishment for drinking wine and for drinking any intoxicant is the same, indicating equal legal treatment in hadd.
